knowledgePoints.title: 多表汇总与贡献率
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 多表汇总与销售贡献率
knowledgePoints.concept: 先明确有效记录及汇总粒度，再以全体汇总作为贡献率分母；不能用筛选后的子集替代总体。
knowledgePoints.syntax:
WITH totals AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, COALESCE(SUM(o.net_cents),0) net_cents
 FROM stores s LEFT JOIN v_order_net o ON o.store_id=s.store_id
  AND o.channel='store' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
 GROUP BY s.store_id
)
SELECT store_id,net_cents,ROUND(100.0*net_cents/NULLIF(SUM(net_cents) OVER(),0),2) sales_pct
FROM totals ORDER BY net_cents DESC,store_id

knowledgePoints.useCase: 管理层需要比较2025年各门店在全体线下净销售中的贡献。
knowledgePoints.comparison: 订单视图一行代表一笔有效订单。左连接保留无订单门店，先按门店聚合才得到可比较的门店净销售。SUM(net_cents) OVER()在全部门店汇总行上求和，每行仍保留门店粒度。窗口内不分区，避免每店贡献率都等于100%。线上订单不归入线下门店总体，不能混入分母。

commonError.example: 改变指标条件、总体分母、相邻月份方向或前三名数量。
commonError.correction: 先按store_id汇总，窗口SUM再作用于每门店一行的结果。

knowledgePoints.notes: 示例采用可逐笔核对的小型数据，练习采用正式业务数据库。金额单位为马币分。

compatibility.detail: 仅在本示例数据与语义范围验证；不代表全部 MySQL 语法兼容。

knowledgePoints.setupSql:
CREATE VIEW v_sales_lines AS SELECT i.order_item_id,o.order_id,o.store_id,o.customer_id,o.session_id,o.channel,o.order_date,i.product_id,i.promotion_id,i.quantity-COALESCE(r.qty,0) AS net_qty,i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents-i.discount_cents-COALESCE(r.refund,0) AS net_cents,(i.quantity-COALESCE(r.qty,0))*i.unit_cost_cents AS cost_cents,i.discount_cents,COALESCE(r.refund,0) AS refund_cents FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id,SUM(quantity) qty,SUM(refund_cents) refund FROM returns WHERE return_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id=i.order_item_id WHERE o.status='completed';
CREATE VIEW v_order_net AS SELECT order_id,store_id,customer_id,session_id,channel,order_date,SUM(net_cents) net_cents,SUM(cost_cents) cost_cents FROM v_sales_lines GROUP BY order_id,store_id,customer_id,session_id,channel,order_date;

teaching.problem: 管理层想知道各门店贡献，比较范围是同期全部线下实体门店。
teaching.codeExplanation: 先左连接订单和门店保留主档，再聚合到门店粒度。SUM OVER 在所有门店行上给出相同总额，NULLIF 保护分母，最后根据销售额和编号排序。
teaching.resultExplanation: 无销售门店仍显示销售额 0；总体也为 0 时贡献率为 NULL。若要看前三门店贡献，应先算总体再筛前三。

WITH totals AS (

 FROM stores s LEFT JOIN v_order_net o ON o.store_id=s.store_id
  AND o.channel='store' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
 GROUP BY s.store_id
)
SELECT * FROM totals ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 3;

knowledgePoints.title: 时间序列与缺失月份
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 月度销售趋势与缺失月份
knowledgePoints.concept: 连续月份是环比的前提；先建立月份轴，再连接实际金额。缺失记录是否代表0需事先定义。
knowledgePoints.useCase: 管理层需要2025年完整12个月的线下净销售趋势，包括没有销售的月份。
knowledgePoints.comparison: 缺失销售记录的月份若直接省略，LAG得到的会是上一条有销售记录，与上一个自然月不同。日期维度先提供12个连续月份，左连接并补0后，每行的上一条才对应相邻月份。先完成月份再开窗，同时保留2025年1月上月值为NULL。上月为0与未知上月具有不同业务含义，但两者都不能直接作为除法分母。

commonError.example: 改变指标条件、总体分母、相邻月份方向或前三名数量。
commonError.correction: 销售先汇总再左连接月份，补0之后再计算LAG。

knowledgePoints.notes: 示例采用可逐笔核对的小型数据，练习采用正式业务数据库。金额单位为马币分。

compatibility.detail: 仅在本示例数据与语义范围验证；不代表全部 MySQL 语法兼容。

CREATE VIEW v_order_net AS SELECT order_id,store_id,customer_id,session_id,channel,order_date,SUM(net_cents) net_cents,SUM(cost_cents) cost_cents FROM v_sales_lines GROUP BY order_id,store_id,customer_id,session_id,channel,order_date;

teaching.problem: 月度趋势必须包含没有发生销售的自然月，否则相邻结果行不能代表相邻月份。
teaching.codeExplanation: 先从日历提取不同月键，对订单按月聚合后左连接、补 0，再按月份使用 LAG。金额变化和百分比各自处理上期 0 或缺失。
teaching.resultExplanation: 例如缺失的 2 月应为 0，3 月即使恢复销售，环比百分比也因基数 0 而不可定义。将月轴换成周轴即可用于周报。

knowledgePoints.title: 分组内排名与前N名
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 各门店销售额前三名商品
knowledgePoints.concept: 先聚合至目标粒度，再按分区排名，最后在外层筛选名次。
knowledgePoints.syntax:
WITH sales AS (
 SELECT store_id,product_id,SUM(net_cents) net_cents FROM v_sales_lines
 WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
 GROUP BY store_id,product_id HAVING SUM(net_cents)>0
), ranked AS (
 SELECT store_id,product_id,net_cents,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY net_cents DESC,product_id) sales_rank FROM sales
)
SELECT store_id,product_id,net_cents,sales_rank FROM ranked WHERE sales_rank<=3 ORDER BY store_id,sales_rank

knowledgePoints.useCase: 商品经理需要2025年每家门店净销售额最高的最多三件商品。
knowledgePoints.comparison: 销售明细直接排名会把同一商品的不同交易当成多件商品。第一层聚合将粒度变为门店商品，第二层才在各门店独立排名。ROW_NUMBER与product_id决胜条件保证并列时仍最多三行，RANK或DENSE_RANK仅按金额排序可能返回更多商品。退款通过明细视图预聚合处理，避免多次退款放大销售金额。

teaching.problem: 商品经理需要每家门店的前三件商品，要求并列时仍最多三件。
teaching.codeExplanation: 先按门店、商品合计净销售，再用 ROW_NUMBER 按门店分区，从高到低编号，以商品编号拆同额。外层应用前三名条件。把分区键改为部门、排序键改为薪资即可得到部门内名单；保留同薪名次时需改用适合并列规则的排名函数。
teaching.resultExplanation: 同额产品以编号稳定排序，不足三件只显示存在的商品。可将分区键改为渠道或从属类别复用。

teaching.problem: 销售和库存贡献不匹配时，可以找出资金占用大却销售贡献小的商品。
teaching.codeExplanation: 分别计算商品年度净销售与期末库存价值，合并商品粒度后各自除以全体总额，比较两个占比的百分点差。
teaching.resultExplanation: 差值为正表示库存占比高于销售占比。采购季节和促销节奏可能造成偏差，应结合库存覆盖天数核查。

knowledgePoints.title: 销售毛利与库存投资回报
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 在统一企业数据库中独立完成：销售毛利与库存投资回报
knowledgePoints.concept: 2025年全部渠道，按类别计算净销售毛利与2024年底/2025年底平均库存标准价值，毛利/平均库存为库存投资回报倍数；保留全部类别。 缺失期初或期末快照时对应类别的平均库存与回报倍数返回NULL。
knowledgePoints.syntax: WITH a AS (SELECT p.category_id,SUM(s.net_cents-s.cost_cents) gross FROM v_sales_lines s JOIN products p ON p.product_id=s.product_id WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.category_id), b AS (SELECT p.category_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(i.snapshot_id)=2*COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id)*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouses) THEN SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents)/2.0 ELSE NULL END avg_stock FROM products p CROSS JOIN warehouses w LEFT JOIN inventory_snapshots i ON i.product_id=p.product_id AND i.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id AND i.snapshot_date IN ('2024-12-31','2025-12-31') GROUP BY p.category_id) SELECT c.category_id,COALESCE(a.gross,0) gross_cents,b.avg_stock avg_stock_cents,ROUND(COALESCE(a.gross,0)/NULLIF(b.avg_stock,0),4) gmroi FROM categories c LEFT JOIN a ON a.category_id=c.category_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.category_id=c.category_id ORDER BY gmroi DESC,c.category_id

teaching.problem: 门店经营需要同时观察每小时销售和人工费用占净销售的比例。
teaching.codeExplanation: 按门店独立汇总销售与当期人员工时和成本，再连接。跨岗位或人员明细不能直接接销售明细；工时和净销售各自作不同指标的分母。
teaching.resultExplanation: 高人工占比可能来自成本升高或销售偏低；用人效和实际加班再复核，零工时返回 NULL。

knowledgePoints.title: 月度经营汇总表
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 在统一企业数据库中独立完成：月度经营汇总表
knowledgePoints.concept: 2025年每月全渠道净销售及毛利、费用分录、人工估算成本、广告支出、采购承诺金额；广告支出独立展示（不并入费用避免潜在双计）；经营贡献=毛利-费用-人工，不是净利润。
knowledgePoints.syntax: WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12'), s AS (SELECT SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(net_cents-cost_cents) gross FROM v_sales_lines WHERE order_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), f AS (SELECT SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7) m,SUM(expense_cents) expense FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7)), h AS (SELECT month_key,SUM(labor_cents) labor FROM v_staff_month WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key), p AS (SELECT SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(ordered_cents) procurement FROM v_po_lines WHERE order_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), a AS (SELECT month_key,SUM(spend_cents) spend FROM marketing_campaigns WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key) SELECT m.month_key,COALESCE(s.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(s.gross,0) gross_cents,COALESCE(f.expense,0) expense_cents,COALESCE(h.labor,0) labor_cents,COALESCE(a.spend,0) advertising_cents,COALESCE(p.procurement,0) committed_purchase_cents,COALESCE(s.gross,0)-COALESCE(f.expense,0)-COALESCE(h.labor,0) operating_contribution_cents FROM m LEFT JOIN s ON s.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN f ON f.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN h ON h.month_key=m.month_key LEFT JOIN p ON p.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN a ON a.month_key=m.month_key ORDER BY m.month_key

parameters.金额: 整数马币分；比率按题设

teaching.problem: 经营月报需把销售、费用、人工、广告及采购承诺放在同一月份轴比较。
teaching.codeExplanation: 为各来源分别定义有效记录和日期字段，各自聚合为月度，再左接完整月份。按题设以毛利减费用及人工计算经营贡献，广告和采购承诺单列展示。
teaching.resultExplanation: 每个自然月一行，可定位贡献转负的月份。单列广告与采购承诺可辅助追查，但是否应纳入扣减要确认是否已计入费用。
